_about: Evelyn Abbott (1843-1901), Jowett Lecturer in Greek History at Balliol: A History of Greece, 3 parts (Putnam and Longmans; title pages dated 1901, 1901 and 1900), raw IA OCR. IA also holds copies catalogued 1888 and 1895, so the 1901 title pages of parts I-II are probably later printings (pre-1930; an inference from the catalogue dates). His translation of Duncker's History of Antiquity is Near Eastern history and is not taken. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. Round du (2026-10-23), raw IA: Hellenica, essays edited by him (Rivingtons, 1880); Pericles and the Golden Age of Athens (1891); A Skeleton Outline of Greek History; Clarendon editions with English notes of Herodotus IX (1887) and V-VI (1893) and, with P. E. Matheson, Demosthenes's Orations against Philip I (1887) and II part I (1903). His translation of Zeller's Outlines, with S. F. Alleyne, is on the zeller shelf; the Life of Jowett with Lewis Campbell is on the lewis-campbell shelf. Not taken: his Selections from Lucian and the Speech on the Crown, whose open scans OCR the English as Greek letters.
